---
title: "Hello Again"
description: "Rebooting this blog on a modern stack, six years later."
date: 2026-07-09
categories: [meta]
---

This blog was set up in early 2020 and then — as blogs do — sat quietly
while other things happened. It's now back, rebuilt on
[Quarto](https://quarto.org), the successor to the
[fastpages](https://github.com/fastai/fastpages) platform it originally
ran on.

The mechanics are simpler now: posts are Markdown files or Jupyter
notebooks in a `posts/` directory, and pushing to the repository
publishes them. No conversion scripts, no Docker, no deprecated
tooling to babysit.

More substantial posts are on the way. In the meantime, the code for
this site lives on [GitHub](https://github.com/computableai/pages).
